sentences.text: Two steps here are carried by sources outside the story: a program serving 63.13 million recipients as of May 2026, and recipients, most of them schoolchildren, falling ill after eating its meals.
The step no source takes is the last one, from one agency's own running count to that count standing as the full national scale of the harm.

By 1 October 2025 three ledgers stood at three different places: BGN, the agency running the program, at 6,517 people; BPOM, the food and drug regulator, at 9,089 people; and JPPI, a civil-society network, at 8,649 children through 27 September.
None of the three publishes the rule that decides what enters it, the served base it accumulated on, or the school outbreak ledger that was already being kept before the program existed.

Outside the totals stand the people who meet each case first: households arranging care the same day, and the puskesmas and district health offices whose investigations turn an incident into the KLB record the national argument is fought over.

The same meals came out of 29,679 SPPG kitchens operating, inside a program that counts 1.28 million program workers, and which of those units the counted cases trace back to is published beside none of the three totals.

q.en: Three institutions published three different totals for the same program. What separates them?

options.en: Each built its total under a different counting rule, over a different window, with a different unit.
The later totals simply picked up cases the earlier ones had not yet received.
One institution has more monitors on the ground, so it sees more of what happens.

note.en: The dueling counts panel sets the three methods side by side: a running agency count since January 2025, a regulator's ledger summed from verified KLB events, and a network's tally of children through 27 September 2025. Two of the figures carry the same as-of date and still sit far apart, so elapsed time alone does not hold the gap, and the panel's rule line keeps them separate: adding, averaging or choosing among them would report a quantity none of the three measured.

q.en: The agency's figure is cumulative since January 2025. What is missing before it can be read as a rate?

options.en: The base it accumulated on: the recipients and portions served across the same months.
A breakdown by province, so each region carries its own share of the total.
Confirmation from the two other institutions that published counts.

note.en: The hidden layer of the claim map names the served base directly: no article places the count over how many recipients and portions the program delivered in the same window. The program step carries 63.13 million recipients as of May 2026, and the count sits beside that figure, never over it. A provincial split still leaves counts without a base, and a count confirmed by another count is still a count without a base.

q.en: Cases get logged against a service unit and it stops cooking. Who carries that first?

options.en: The unit's kitchen crew, and the smallholders and vendors it buys from daily.
The national program budget, which absorbs the pause.
The published totals, which are adjusted when a unit stops.

note.en: The incidence panel follows the same meals to the producing side: 29,679 SPPG kitchens operating, and 142,387 suppliers documented as a program-wide total as of May 2026, with crews not earning on the days a unit stops cooking. Which units the counted cases trace back to, and what happened to those units afterwards, is published beside none of the three totals, so nothing in the registry shows a total moving with a stoppage.

prompt.en: Before the panels: a story counts how many people a national meal program made ill. Which side of it do you expect to go missing?

options.en: The counting rule: what has to happen for a case to enter any of these ledgers.
The base underneath: how many recipients and portions were served in the same months.
The first payers: the families and the clinics that meet each case the same day.
The producing side: the kitchen units that cooked the counted meals, their crews and their suppliers.

sentences.text: Program Makan Bergizi Gratis berjalan dalam skala nasional, dengan 63,13 juta penerima per Mei 2026, dan langkah dari program itu ke penerima yang jatuh sakit ditopang sumber di luar artikelnya sendiri.
Rantainya berhenti di langkah terakhir: tidak ada sumber dalam registri yang menyatakan hitungan berjalan sebuah badan adalah ukuran utuh skala keracunan secara nasional.
Titik tempat sumber-sumber itu berpisah adalah hitungannya: BGN mencatat 6.517 orang sejak Januari 2025, BPOM 9.089 orang per 1 Oktober 2025, dan JPPI 8.649 anak per 27 September 2025.

Ketiganya dibiarkan berdampingan tanpa dilebur, sebab tiap total lahir dari aturan hitung, jendela waktu, dan satuan yang berbeda, sementara definisi kasus di balik masing-masing angka tidak pernah diumumkan.
Penyebutnya juga belum dibuka: berapa penerima dan porsi yang tersalurkan pada rentang bulan yang sama, dan seberapa sering keracunan pangan di lingkungan sekolah tercatat sebelum program ini ada.

Di luar bingkai berdiri keluarga yang mengurus perawatan pada hari yang sama, puskesmas dan dinas kesehatan yang membuka catatan KLB, dan 29.679 dapur SPPG yang beroperasi per Mei 2026 bersama kru serta pemasok lokal yang ikut berhenti ketika sebuah unit berhenti memasak.

q.en: Three institutions publish three different totals for the same program. What is doing most of the work in that gap?
q.id: Tiga lembaga menerbitkan tiga total berbeda untuk program yang sama. Apa yang paling menentukan jarak di antaranya?

options.en: Each total is built from a different counting rule, over a different window, with a different unit.
options.id: Tiap total dibangun dari aturan hitung yang berbeda, pada jendela waktu yang berbeda, dengan satuan yang berbeda.

options.en: More outlets repeated the larger figures, so those totals grew.
options.id: Lebih banyak media mengulang angka yang besar, sehingga total itu ikut membesar.

options.en: The largest figure is simply the most recent one, and the others lag behind it.
options.id: Angka terbesar sekadar angka paling baru, sedangkan sisanya tertinggal di belakangnya.

note.en: The three counts panel puts the methods side by side: BGN keeps a running count of people inside its own program, BPOM sums victims from verified KLB events across regions, JPPI tallies children reported affected through 27 September 2025. BGN and BPOM even stand on the same date, 1 October 2025, at 6,517 people and 9,089 people.
note.id: Panel tiga hitungan menaruh metodenya berdampingan: BGN memegang hitungan berjalan atas orang di dalam programnya sendiri, BPOM menjumlahkan korban dari kejadian luar biasa yang diverifikasi lintas daerah, JPPI menabulasi anak yang dilaporkan terdampak hingga 27 September 2025. BGN dan BPOM bahkan berdiri pada tanggal yang sama, 1 Oktober 2025, pada 6.517 orang dan 9.089 orang.

q.en: The counts are published as cumulative totals. What are they placed over?
q.id: Hitungan itu diumumkan sebagai total kumulatif. Di atas basis apa angka itu diletakkan?

options.en: Over the recipients and portions the program served across the same months.
options.id: Di atas penerima dan porsi yang tersalurkan pada rentang bulan yang sama.

options.en: Over the number of SPPG kitchens that cooked the program's meals.
options.id: Di atas jumlah dapur SPPG yang memasak menu program.

options.en: Over nothing. No served base is published beside any of the three totals.
options.id: Tidak di atas basis apa pun. Tidak ada basis penyaluran yang diumumkan berdampingan dengan satu pun dari tiga total itu.

note.en: The registry does carry served figures, 63.13 million recipients and 29,679 SPPG kitchens operating, but both stand at May 2026 while the counts stop at 27 September and 1 October 2025. Nothing lines the two up, so no rate comes out of them, and the served base is logged as one of the parts the story never opens.
note.id: Registri memang memuat angka penyaluran, 63,13 juta penerima dan 29.679 dapur SPPG beroperasi, tetapi keduanya berdiri pada Mei 2026 sementara hitungan korban berhenti pada 27 September dan 1 Oktober 2025. Tidak ada yang menyejajarkan keduanya, jadi tidak ada laju kejadian yang bisa dibaca dari sana, dan basis penyaluran itu tercatat sebagai bagian yang belum dibuka.

q.en: One child is counted in an incident. Who meets the cost of that single case first, before it reaches any national total?
q.id: Seorang anak terhitung dalam sebuah insiden. Siapa yang lebih dulu menanggung biaya kasus itu, sebelum kasusnya sampai ke total nasional mana pun?

options.en: The agency running the program, which logs the case into its national total.
options.id: Badan pelaksana program, yang mencatatkan kasus itu ke dalam total nasionalnya.

options.en: The child's household, then the puskesmas, district hospital and district health office that treat it and open the investigation.
options.id: Rumah tangga anak itu, lalu puskesmas, rumah sakit daerah, dan dinas kesehatan yang merawatnya dan membuka penyelidikan.

options.en: The food and drug regulator, which verifies the KLB event before the case is recorded anywhere.
options.id: Regulator obat dan makanan, yang memverifikasi kejadian luar biasa itu sebelum kasusnya tercatat di mana pun.

note.en: The downstream panel starts at home and at the clinic: symptoms, a visit, school days lost the same day, and the district health office opening the investigation that turns an incident into a KLB record. The label the national dispute is fought over is produced on that floor, and the routine surveillance ledger those facilities feed is cited by none of the three counts.
note.id: Panel efek lanjutan bermula di rumah dan di fasilitas kesehatan: gejala, satu kunjungan, hari sekolah yang hilang pada hari yang sama, lalu dinas kesehatan membuka penyelidikan yang mengubah insiden menjadi catatan KLB. Label yang diperselisihkan di tingkat nasional justru diproduksi di lantai itu, dan pembukuan surveilans rutin yang diisi fasilitas-fasilitas itu tidak dikutip satu pun dari tiga hitungan.

prompt.en: Before you scroll: in a story about a program that feeds tens of millions and a running count of who got sick from it, which side of the claim goes missing first?
prompt.id: Sebelum menggulir: dalam cerita tentang program yang memberi makan puluhan juta orang dan hitungan berjalan siapa yang jatuh sakit karenanya, sisi mana dari klaim ini yang lebih dulu menghilang?

options.en: The served base: how many recipients and portions the program delivered over the same months.
options.id: Basis penyalurannya: berapa penerima dan porsi yang tersalurkan pada rentang bulan yang sama.

options.en: The counting rule behind each figure: which symptoms qualify, and who verifies a report.
options.id: Aturan hitung di balik tiap angka: gejala apa yang memenuhi syarat, dan siapa yang memverifikasi laporan.

options.en: The kitchen side: the unit that cooked the meals, its crew, and the local suppliers that stop when it stops.
options.id: Sisi dapurnya: unit yang memasak porsinya, kru dapur, dan pemasok lokal yang ikut berhenti ketika unit itu berhenti.

options.en: The baseline: how often school food poisoning was recorded before the program existed.
options.id: Garis dasarnya: seberapa sering keracunan pangan di lingkungan sekolah tercatat sebelum program ini ada.
